name: tfl_annual_station_counts
title: TfL Annual Station Counts: typical-day and annualised entries and exits per station
description: TfL's yearly station counts for the Underground, London Overground, DLR and Elizabeth line (TfL Rail before 2022; trams in 2021 only), from 2017: entries and exits on a typical day of each day type in the autumn count period, plus weekly, 12-week (from 2022) and annualised entries-and-exits totals, for each station. Published by Transport for London as one workbook per year in its open data bucket. One row per year, station row and published figure.

licenses.title: TfL Transport Data Service licence (based on OGL v2.0) — attribution: "Powered by TfL Open Data"

sources.title: Transport for London — open data bucket (crowding.data.tfl.gov.uk, folder 'Annual Station Counts', one annualised entry/exit workbook per year)

update_cadence: TfL publishes each year's workbook the following summer, and occasionally re-issues earlier years with revisions; checked weekly.
caveats: Typical-day figures (day_type Monday ... Sunday, 'Weekday (Mon-Thu)', 'Midweek (Tue-Thu)' etc.) are averages for a typical day of that type in TfL's autumn count period, not totals; 'Weekly', '12-week' and 'Annualised' are TfL's own scaled totals of entries plus exits. Sum like with like: never add typical-day and annualised rows together.

The day types change between years: 2017 has 'Weekday (Mon-Fri)', Saturday and Sunday; 2018-2021 split Weekday (Mon-Thu) from Friday; from 2022 TfL gives Monday, 'Midweek (Tue-Thu)', Friday, Saturday and Sunday plus weekly and 12-week totals. day_type and measure are TfL's labels, with direction labels ('entries'/'Entries'/'Entry', 'en/ex') mapped to one spelling each.

The annualisation factor changes: TfL labels it 'p789 factor' for 2017-2019 and 2021-2022 and 'LD2 factor' (lockdown) for 2020; later workbooks don't say. Figures for 2020 and 2021 reflect Covid-19 restrictions; do not use them as a baseline.

coverage and source are TfL's notes, verbatim: whether a figure is gateline entries/exits or boardings/alightings, and how it was measured (gateline, taps, automatic passenger counts, loadweigh, manual counts, scaled). Their wording changes between years.

Interchange stations have one row per mode, and from 2022 some rows only point to another mode's row ('---see LU---', '---see LO---', '---see EZL---' in coverage) — including the Elizabeth line rows at Bond Street, Tottenham Court Road, Paddington, Liverpool Street, Farringdon, Whitechapel, Ealing Broadway and Stratford. Their counts are 0 in 2022 and null from 2023, as published: those stations' users are counted in the row pointed to, so this source cannot separate the Elizabeth line from the Underground there.

Station names and codes are TfL's, verbatim (whitespace trimmed); names change (e.g. 'Woolwich EZL' became 'Woolwich EL'). nlc is TfL's National Location Code (headed MNLC from 2022), asc its station code (MASC); mode codes also change (TfLRail became EZL from 2020).
TfL's 2025 workbook has two different Shenfield (EZL) rows; both are published as given. sheet_row is the Excel row number in TfL's sheet and tells such rows apart.
The 2017-2021 folders also hold quarter-hour workbooks (ByQhrEntryExit), which are not republished here.
Attribution required by the licence: "Powered by TfL Open Data".

resources.name: annual_station_counts_parquet
resources.description: One row per year, station row, day type and direction (wide -> long), sorted by year, sheet_row, measure, day type. Derived from the raw zip, which is authoritative.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Count year (the workbook's folder in TfL's bucket).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: TfL mode code, verbatim: LU, LO, DLR, TfLRail (to 2019), EZL (from 2020), TRM (2021 only).

fields.name: nlc
fields.description: TfL National Location Code of the station row (column NLC, or MNLC from 2022).

fields.name: asc
fields.description: TfL station code (column ASC, or MASC from 2022), e.g. 'ACTu'.

fields.name: station
fields.description: Station name, verbatim apart from trimmed whitespace.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: TfL's coverage note, verbatim, e.g. 'Station entry/exit', 'Boarding/alighting', '---see LU---'.

fields.name: day_type
fields.description: TfL's day-type label: Weekday (Mon-Fri), Weekday (Mon-Thu), Monday, Midweek (Tue-Thu), Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Weekly, 12-week or Annualised.

fields.name: measure
fields.description: entries, exits, or entries_and_exits (TfL's 'en/ex', used by the Weekly, 12-week and Annualised totals).

fields.name: count
fields.description: TfL's figure: a typical-day average for day types Monday ... Sunday, a total for Weekly, 12-week and Annualised. Null where TfL gives a '---' placeholder.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: The workbook this row came from, as '<year>/<TfL filename>' (its path in the raw zip).

fields.name: sheet_row
fields.description: Excel row number of the station row in TfL's sheet.

resources.name: raw_zip
resources.description: Every year's annualised entry/exit workbook from TfL's 'Annual Station Counts' folder, unmodified, as '<year>/<TfL filename>', in one deterministic zip.
